bullet: Tool module gone on resume (`F27.custom-tool-missing-on-resume`), known bug.
script:
W0=$(control-agent-server logs --grep 'Failed to import module' | jq -r .total_matching)
control-agent-server restart --reset-config
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$MCID" --expect 200 --check tool_module_qualnames.qa_f27_echo eq qa_f27_tools --quiet
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$MCID/events" --json '{"role": "user", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Reply with the single word ok."}], "run": false}' --expect 2xx,4xx --save F27.custom-tool-missing-on-resume/send  # bug
control-agent-server logs --grep 'Failed to import module' --expect-min "$((W0 + 1))"
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$MCID/events/search" --expect 200 --check items len-ge 1 --quiet  # bug
failed_command: control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$MCID/events" --json '{"role": "user", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Reply with the single word ok."}], "run": false}' --expect 2xx,4xx --save F27.custom-tool-missing-on-resume/send
